description: Open a NEW project when the work has no home; it needs slug, name and scope. Propose them to the person FIRST. update=true renames a project you own and rewrites its scope when the person asks or the scope is wrong; the slug stays. invite brings someone in by email.

invite.description: Email of a person to bring in. Returns a checkout link if a team plan is needed.

scope.description: What belongs here and what does not: the subject AND what is out.

update.description: true: change name and scope of the existing project at slug.

name: arroway_start_project
title: Open a new project
